newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea central bank sells dlrs at around 859.60.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea central bank sells dlrs at around 859.60.

text.p: The Bank of Korea, South Korea's central bank, sold dollars in early Wednesday morning trading at around 859.60 won to slow the local unit's fall, dealers said.
"The dollar's strength against the yen on world markets is a main cause for the won's fall," said a domestic bank dealer.
The won opened at an intraday high of 859.50 and touched a low of 860.00. It hovers around 859.70 at 0100 GMT.
The dollar was trading at 121.40/45 yen in morning trading in Tokyo, compared with 121.20/30 on Tuesday.
Dealers said South Korea's rising trade deficits also put a downward pressure on the won.
